name: B10-0065/2026 (The Left) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament states its position on the disputed presidential election in Honduras of 30 November 2025. It does not change any law. It rejects political violence and foreign interference, especially from the United States, and says the election did not meet the conditions for a free vote. It calls for a transition that respects the will of the Honduran people, better protection for politicians and journalists, and new electoral reforms.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a call to act.
- **Who it affects:** Honduran authorities, political leaders, and the United States.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to European Union bodies, member states, Honduras, the Organization of American States, and the United Nations human rights office.
